_meta.batch: Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset + Grimoire 3 Iron Bell + Grimoire 4 Parlor 0 (54 terminow). Uzupelnia luke miedzy batch_02 (Grimoire 1) a batch_03 (Grimoire 5) - kontynuacja chronologiczna watku Grimoire'a.

new_glossary_terms.Mess Hall: Mesa - pomieszczenie jadalne na okrecie, termin morski
new_glossary_terms.Iron Bell/Mermaid's Tongue: potwierdzone przez usera jako Żelazny Dzwon / Język Syreny - brak gry slow litera-po-literze (sprawdzone w calym zrodle), jest za to gra slow 'tongue'=jezyk(organ)/jezyk(mowa) ktora PRZEKLADA SIE 1:1 na polskie 'jezyk' (Section ds152 w Grimoire 6 Parlor 2, do przetlumaczenia w kolejnej partii)

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: Did Sinthia [i]really[/i] think we'd use that boat?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Czy Sinthia [i]naprawdę[/i] sądziła, że skorzystamy z tej łodzi?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: She seemed really [i]off[/i]. Did something happen...?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Wydawała się naprawdę [i]nie sobą[/i]. Coś się stało...?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: We're not really going to leave, are we?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Tak naprawdę nie zamierzamy odpłynąć, prawda?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: No, we're not done. Not yet.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Nie, jeszcze nie skończyliśmy. Jeszcze nie.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: Remember what Sinthia said? Everyone's gathering in the Mess Hall.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Pamiętasz, co powiedziała Sinthia? Wszyscy zbierają się w Mesie.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: Not just that, but we're back on the surface, too.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Nie tylko to - wróciliśmy też na powierzchnię.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: So what are we waiting for?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: Or... did she just forget to take the submarine back to town?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Albo... czy ona po prostu zapomniała popłynąć z powrotem do miasta?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: I think she's just getting scared.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: Myślę, że po prostu zaczyna się bać.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: Of the [i]truth[/i] - of facing the truth - and all the consequences of it.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.pl: [i]Prawdy[/i] - zmierzenia się z prawdą - i wszystkich jej konsekwencji.
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.en: Scared of what? Exposing a murderer?
Conversation/Grimoire 2 Foredeck Sunset/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Reques.en: The Iron Bell is a mechanism that connects to another clue...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Reques.pl: Żelazny Dzwon to mechanizm, który łączy się z innym dowodem...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Reques.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Reques.en: The Iron Bell is a mechanism that slots into another clue from above...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Reques.pl: Żelazny Dzwon to mechanizm, który wsuwa się w inny dowód od góry...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Reques.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: It's a mechanism that connects to another clue...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.pl: To mechanizm, który łączy się z innym dowodem...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: ...if the Bell attaches onto the top of the [i]Cauldron...[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: What are you suggesting? We carry it along the hallway, down a ladder, along [i]another[/i] hallway-
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.pl: Co sugerujesz? Że poniesiemy go korytarzem, w dół po drabinie, [i]kolejnym[/i] korytarzem-
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: It's not a bell at all.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: It [i]is[/i] a bell, but it's broken.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: So - we've been calling it a [i]bell[/i] this whole time...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: It's not a bell at all.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: It [i]is[/i] a bell, but it's broken.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: We've been calling it a bell this whole time...
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: Then - it must be possible to move it down into the room [i]below?[/i] - into the Illusion Theatre?
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.pl: W takim razie - da się go przenieść do pokoju [i]poniżej?[/i] - do Teatru Iluzji?
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en:
Yeah.
Let's take another look at this room.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.pl:
Tak.
Rzućmy jeszcze raz okiem na ten pokój.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.en: [i]No, no[/i] - there's gotta be some simple way to do it.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.pl: [i]Nie, nie[/i] - musi być jakiś prosty sposób, żeby to zrobić.
Conversation/Grimoire 3 Iron Bell/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: Sinthia's decided to lock us in.
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Tadpole

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: Look, I know this isn't ideal, but - this is just how it needs to be until we can-
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.pl: Słuchajcie, wiem, że to niezbyt komfortowe, ale - musi tak być, dopóki nie będziemy mogli-
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: She may have gone mad, we're still assessing.
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.pl: Możliwe, że oszalała, wciąż to ustalamy.
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Wirman

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: I've - just locked the Fore Deck access, just for the [i]time being-[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.pl: Ja - po prostu zamknęłam dostęp do Pokładu Dziobowego, tylko [i]na razie-[/i]
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: She's worried the culprit will attempt to escape as soon as they're named.
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.pl: Martwi się, że sprawca spróbuje uciec, gdy tylko zostanie wskazany.
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: Ooh, we're naming the culprit? Lovely! Been looking forward to this-
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.pl: Ooo, wskazujemy sprawcę? Cudownie! Nie mogłam się doczekać-
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: We're still doing that? I thought Sinthia fired the detective dudes?
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.pl: Wciąż to robimy? Myślałem, że Sinthia wywaliła tych detektywów?
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Dirk

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.en: On the [i]contrary[/i] - we've been pretty busy.
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.pl: A co innego? Rozwiązywaliśmy tę zagadkę.
Conversation/Grimoire 4 Parlor 0/Section.speaker: Grimoire
